newsitem.title: USA: IHOP September same-store sales rose 1.8.
newsitem.headline: IHOP September same-store sales rose 1.8.

text.p: IHOP Corp said Thursday that same-store sales for the fiscal month of September rose 1.8 percent, compared to an increase of 0.7 percent in the same period last year.

The company noted that this is the fourth consecutive month of positive same store sales for the company and attributed the strong performance to three main factors: the company's new advertising campaign initiated in May 1996; the company's new menu, which went systemwide in the latter part of 1995; and an improved focus on unit level operations.
